UIInfo.title: Bubble Hands & Hidden Drawers
UIInfo.subtitle: A tiny place with tiny treasures—can you solve it?

lessonPuzzle.backgroundText: Drawers hold little things. Bathrooms help us stay clean and healthy. Clean hands keep germs from sneaking into our day.
lessonPuzzle.question: Before we eat, what should we do with our hands?
lessonPuzzle.successResponse: Yes! Clean hands are hero hands. 🌟
lessonPuzzle.failureResponse: Not quite—think bubbles, water, and a happy scrub!

clueToNextTag.text: Now tiptoe to the room with the big warm glow. Look above the fire place—on the mantle, a treasure waits.
clueToNextTag.hint1: Head around the corner to the living area.

UIInfo.title: The Five-Step Spell
UIInfo.subtitle: A clean clue and a warmer place ahead…

lessonPuzzle.backgroundText: Put these in order for proper handwashing: Wet, Soap, Scrub, Rinse, Dry.
lessonPuzzle.question: What’s the correct sequence? (Type the first letters)
lessonPuzzle.successResponse: Perfect sequence. Your future self thanks you.
lessonPuzzle.failureResponse: Close—start with water, end with a towel. Try again!

clueToNextTag.text: Next, seek the place where stories warm the room. Above the flames is a shelf of honor—the mantle holds your next mark.

UIInfo.title: The Hearth’s Riddle
UIInfo.subtitle: From hidden drawer to glowing lore…

lessonPuzzle.backgroundText: A good clue makes you look twice. A good habit makes you live longer. We’re going to use both.
lessonPuzzle.question: One word connects BOTH of these: (1) what you do to hands with soap and water, and (2) what fire does to cold air. What word is it?
lessonPuzzle.successResponse: Exactly. Clean and warm—two classic upgrades.
lessonPuzzle.failureResponse: Not quite. Think: soap makes one thing better… fire makes another thing better.

clueToNextTag.text: Go to the heart of the room—where heat gathers and shadows dance. Above the fireplace, the mantle is waiting.

UIInfo.title: Where Warmth Meets Order
UIInfo.subtitle: A small drawer. A larger lesson. A hotter destination.

lessonPuzzle.backgroundText: In systems and in homes, reliability comes from rituals: the small repeated acts that prevent big failures. Hygiene is fault prevention. Organization is latency reduction.
lessonPuzzle.question: You found this in a drawer. Now choose the principle: What is the real reason handwashing works so well—removing germs or killing them?
lessonPuzzle.successResponse: Right. Mostly removal—friction + surfactant + rinse. Simple. Powerful.
lessonPuzzle.failureResponse: Not the best choice for this puzzle. Think friction and rinse—not chemical warfare..

clueToNextTag.text: Proceed to the room’s hearth—the architectural “center of gravity.” Above the fireplace, the mantle holds the next step.
